theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ v : Euclid P, v ∈ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2 ↔ ‖x + lam • v‖ < 2) ∧ IsOpen (dilation x lam '' ball 0 2) ∧ (lam ≤ 1 → ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - lam → ball 0 2 ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2 ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, lam * R ≤ 1 → closedBall 0 R ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2)
